# Load data files
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyplots)
library(ggplot2)

# specify the directory where the files are located
dir_path <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-enriquemontes01@gmail.com/My Drive/GDrive/OCED_AOML/WS_cruises/plankton_imaging/CPICS/TS.Master_selection"

# obtain a list of file names in the directory
file_names <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = ".txt", full.names = TRUE)

# loop over each file and import the tables (use this for DATES)
for (file in file_names) {
  table_name <- gsub(".txt", "", basename(file)) # get the name of the table from the file name
  assign(table_name, read.table(file = file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t") %>%
           mutate(date = as.POSIXct(substr(V1, start = 24, stop = 36), format="%Y%m%d_%H%M", tz="UTC")))
}

```


# Match file name to cruise data using DATE 
```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

dir_path2 <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-enriquemontes01@gmail.com/My Drive/GDrive/OCED_AOML/WS_cruises/plankton_imaging/CPICS/ws_cruise_ctd"
file_name <- list.files(path = dir_path2, pattern = "ctd_meta_up_to_ws24314.csv", full.names = TRUE)
ctd_meta <- read.csv(file_name, fill = TRUE)

# Parse dt_list securely and concisely
dt_list <- as.POSIXct(
  sprintf("%04d%02d%02d %s", ctd_meta$year, ctd_meta$month, ctd_meta$day, ctd_meta$time_gmt),
  format = "%Y%m%d %I:%M:%S %p", 
  tz = "UTC"
)

################################################################################
# Detect short transit times between stations
################################################################################
# Vectorized difference calculation in mins
time_differences_mins <- as.numeric(diff(dt_list), units = "mins")

time_diff_df <- data.frame(
  start_time = dt_list[-length(dt_list)],
  end_time = dt_list[-1],
  time_difference_mins = time_differences_mins
)

# CTD time stamps of consecutive stations within less than 20 min
short_timestamps <- dt_list[which(time_differences_mins < 20)]

################################################################################
# Match CPICS records to CTD times & Check unaccounted records
################################################################################
class_names <- c("Acantharea", "Centric", "Ceratium", "Chaetoceros", "Chaetognaths", 
                 "Chain2", "Chain3", "Ostracods", "Copepods", "Decapods", "Echinoderms", 
                 "Guinardia", "Jellies", "Larvaceans", "Neocalyptrella", "Noctiluca", 
                 "pellets", "Polychaets", "Pteropods", "Tricho")

date_limit <- as.POSIXct("2024-11-30", tz = "UTC")
buffer_sec <- 10 * 60 

# Pre-calculate start and end intervals for fast vectorized comparisons
interval_start <- dt_list - buffer_sec
interval_end <- c(dt_list[-1] - buffer_sec, date_limit + 1)

# Process classes in a single pass
results <- setNames(lapply(class_names, function(cname) {
  
  # Fetch ALL data to ensure no unaccounted records slip by
  dts_all <- get(paste0("class.", cname))$date
  
  counts <- integer(length(dt_list))
  accounted <- logical(length(dts_all)) # Tracks if a date falls into any interval
  
  # Check all dates against intervals
  for (i in seq_along(dt_list)) {
    idx <- dts_all >= interval_start[i] & dts_all < interval_end[i]
    counts[i] <- sum(idx & dts_all <= date_limit) # Apply date_limit ONLY to the final count
    accounted[idx] <- TRUE
  }
  
  list(counts = counts, unaccounted = dts_all[!accounted])
  
}), class_names)

# Assemble the final concentration dataframe efficiently
conc_occ_final <- data.frame(date = dt_list)
for (cname in class_names) conc_occ_final[[cname]] <- results[[cname]]$counts

# Combine with metadata and calculate volume
taxa_meta <- cbind(ctd_meta, conc_occ_final) %>%
  mutate(
    sampled_vol_per_min = max(sampled_vol_per_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vol_sampled = sampled_vol_per_min * conc_deployDurMin
  )

################################################################################
# Output Unaccounted Records & Summary Stats
################################################################################
# Print unaccounted dates per class
for (cname in class_names) {
  cat("Unaccounted dates for class:", cname, "\n")
  print(results[[cname]]$unaccounted)
  cat("\n")
}

# Pre-calculate boolean vectors to simplify stat logic
has_vol <- !is.na(taxa_meta$total_vol_sampled)
has_seascape <- !is.na(taxa_meta$X8.day.seascapes)

sampling_events_img <- sum(has_vol)
seascape_total <- sum(has_seascape)
seascape_match <- sum(has_seascape & has_vol)
total_casts <- nrow(taxa_meta)
percent_match <- round((seascape_match / sampling_events_img) * 100, 0)

# Calculates number of stations occupied during each cruise
station_num_per_cruise <- tapply(taxa_meta$Station, taxa_meta$cruiseID, function(x) length(unique(x)))

# Print stats
cat("Total number CTD casts:", total_casts, "\n")
cat("Percent of CTD casts with seascape match:", round((seascape_total / total_casts) * 100, 0), "%\n")
cat("Percent of CTD casts with images (image profiles):", round((sampling_events_img / total_casts) * 100, 0), "%\n")
cat("Percent of image profiles matched to seascapes:", percent_match, "%\n\n")

print(as.table(station_num_per_cruise))
```

# # Calculate plankton concentration time series 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

# ==========================================
# 1. SETUP & TOGGLE (Phytoplankton or Zooplankton)
# ==========================================
analysis_mode <- "zoo" # Change to "phyto" of "zoo" for zooplankton

phyto_cols <- c("Centric", "Ceratium", "Chaetoceros", "Chain2", "Chain3", 
                "Guinardia", "Neocalyptrella", "Noctiluca", "Tricho")
zoo_cols <- c("Acantharea", "Chaetognaths", "Ostracods", "Copepods", "Decapods", 
              "Echinoderms", "Jellies", "Larvaceans", "Polychaets", "Pteropods")

target_cols <- if(analysis_mode == "phyto") phyto_cols else zoo_cols
selected_group <- if(analysis_mode == "phyto") "Chaetoceros" else "Copepods"

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA TRANSFORMATION
# ==========================================
taxa_meta_long <- taxa_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_vol_sampled)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(target_cols), ~ (. / total_vol_sampled) * 1e6)) %>%
  select(Station, dec_lat, dec_lon, year, month, date, Avg.chl.a..ug.L.,
         temp..degC., salinity, total_vol_sampled, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(target_cols), names_to = "species", values_to = "species_concentration")

# ==========================================
# 3. FILTERING & DATE GROUPING
# ==========================================
summary_selected <- taxa_meta_long %>%
  filter(species == selected_group, species_concentration > 0) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  # Extract earliest day of the month to build the date
  mutate(earliest_day = min(as.numeric(format(date, "%d")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    date_grouped = as.Date(paste(year, month, earliest_day, sep = "-")),
    season = factor(case_when(
      month %in% 1:3 ~ "Winter",
      month %in% 4:6 ~ "Spring",
      month %in% 7:9 ~ "Summer",
      month %in% 10:12 ~ "Fall"
    ), levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  ) %>%
  select(-earliest_day)

cat("Maximum concentration value:", max(summary_selected$species_concentration), "\n")
cat("Maximum seawater temperature:", max(summary_selected$temp..degC.), "\n")
cat("Minimum seawater temperature:", min(summary_selected$temp..degC.), "\n\n")

# Print stats
stats_values <- summary_selected %>%
  group_by(date_grouped) %>%
  summarise(
    min_val = min(species_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(species_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(species_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print("Medians per date:")
print(stats_values)

# ==========================================
# 4. TIME SERIES PLOT (sel_box)
# ==========================================
custom_date_labels <- format(sort(unique(summary_selected$date_grouped)), "%Y-%m")

sel_box <- ggplot(summary_selected, aes(x = factor(date_grouped), y = species_concentration)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white", notch = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25, aes(color = temp..degC.), size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Temperature (°C)", option = "inferno", limits = c(14, 34)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), limits = c(1e2, 1e5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = custom_date_labels) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = expression("Density (org. m"^"-3"~")")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )
print(sel_box)

# ==========================================
# 5. SEASONAL PLOT WITH COUNTS (tidyplot aesthetic)
# ==========================================
obs_counts <- summary_selected %>% count(season)
print("Number of observations per season:")
print(obs_counts)

# Create safe labels mapped to the season factor
season_labels <- setNames(paste0(obs_counts$season, "\n(n=", obs_counts$n, ")"), obs_counts$season)

# Apply the new labels directly to the dataframe so ggpubr can match them
summary_selected$season_label <- factor(season_labels[as.character(summary_selected$season)], levels = season_labels)

# Replicate the default tidyplot color palette
tidy_colors <- c(
  "#5fa2ce", # Winter (Blue)
  "#78cbf0", # Spring (Light Blue)
  "#f1d15a", # Summer (Yellow)
  "#d68746"  # Fall (Orange)
)
names(tidy_colors) <- season_labels

tidy_plot2 <- ggplot(summary_selected, aes(x = season_label, y = species_concentration, fill = season_label, color = season_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5, outlier.size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tidy_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tidy_colors) +
  
  # Generate the significance brackets (Bypassing the tidyplot bug)
  geom_pwc(
    ref.group = season_labels["Summer"],
    method = "t.test",
    label = "{p.format}", # Uses unadjusted p-value format to avoid the rstatix bug
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.5,
    step.increase = 0.08
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)), limits = c(1e2, 1e5)) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = expression("Density (org. m"^"-3"~")")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 32, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0", linewidth = 0.5), # Match tidyplot grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(tidy_plot2)
```

# # Calculate plankton concentrations per seascape class
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# ==========================================
# 1. SETUP & TOGGLE (Phytoplankton or Zooplankton)
# ==========================================
analysis_mode <- "phyto" # Change to "zoo" for zooplankton

phyto_cols <- c("Centric", "Ceratium", "Chaetoceros", "Chain2", "Chain3", 
                "Guinardia", "Neocalyptrella", "Noctiluca", "Tricho")
zoo_cols <- c("Acantharea", "Chaetognaths", "Ostracods", "Copepods", "Decapods", 
              "Echinoderms", "Jellies", "Larvaceans", "Polychaets", "Pteropods")

target_cols <- if(analysis_mode == "phyto") phyto_cols else zoo_cols

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PIPELINE & AGGREGATION
# ==========================================
# Clean, filter, pivot, and calculate average concentrations directly
avg_concentration_per_class <- taxa_meta %>%
  select(X8.day.seascapes, total_vol_sampled, month, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(X8.day.seascapes), !is.na(total_vol_sampled), month >= 7) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(target_cols), names_to = "species", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(concentration = (count / total_vol_sampled) * 1e6) %>%
  filter(concentration > 0) %>%
  group_by(species, X8.day.seascapes) %>%
  summarize(mean_concentration = mean(concentration, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000, .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(X8.day.seascapes %in% c("3", "11", "13", "15", "21", "27"))

# ==========================================
# 3. FACTOR FORMATTING & COLOR MAPPING
# ==========================================
# Order seascapes
avg_concentration_per_class$X8.day.seascapes <- factor(
  avg_concentration_per_class$X8.day.seascapes, 
  levels = c("3", "11", "13", "15", "21", "27")
)

# Order species by their overall sum of means
avg_concentration_per_class <- avg_concentration_per_class %>%
  mutate(species = fct_reorder(species, mean_concentration, .fun = sum))

# Apply the appropriate labels and colors based on mode
if(analysis_mode == "phyto") {
  avg_concentration_per_class <- avg_concentration_per_class %>%
    mutate(species = fct_recode(species,
      "Hemidiscus spp" = "Noctiluca",
      "Neoceratium spp" = "Ceratium",
      "Trichodesmium spp" = "Tricho",
      "Neocalyptrella spp" = "Neocalyptrella",
      "Chaetoceros spp" = "Chaetoceros",
      "Coscinodiscus spp" = "Centric",
      "Guinardia striata" = "Guinardia",
      "Mixed Chain Diatoms" = "Chain2",
      "Skeletonema spp" = "Chain3"
    ))
  spp_colors <- c("#B4B87FFF", "#9C913FFF", "#585B33FF", "#6EA8ABFF", "#397893FF", 
                  "#31333FFF", "#8F5715FF", "#BA9A44FF", "#CFBB83FF")
} else {
  avg_concentration_per_class <- avg_concentration_per_class %>%
    mutate(species = fct_recode(species,
      "Polychaetes" = "Polychaets",
      "Acantharea spp" = "Acantharea",
      "Gelatinous" = "Jellies"
    ))
  spp_colors <- c("#551F00FF", "#889D35FF", "#DF7700FF", "#F5B642FF", "#FFF179FF", 
                  "#C3F4F6FF", "#6AD5E8FF", "#32B2DAFF", "#7992A6FF", "#C0D1CEFF")
}

# ==========================================
# 4. PLOTS
# ==========================================
seascape_labels <- c("TST", "TSU", "SGMI", "TS", "WBHN", "HE")
font_size <- 32

# Plot 1: Absolute Mean Concentration
avg_stackplot <- ggplot(avg_concentration_per_class, aes(x = X8.day.seascapes, y = mean_concentration, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spp_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = seascape_labels) +
  labs(x = "Seascape class", y = expression("Density (org. m"^"-3"~") × 10"^3)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = font_size, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = font_size, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = font_size, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 24)), 
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = font_size),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(avg_stackplot)

# Calculate Relative Percentages
avg_concentration_percent <- avg_concentration_per_class %>%
  group_by(X8.day.seascapes) %>%
  mutate(mean_concentration_percent = mean_concentration / sum(mean_concentration) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot 2: Relative Concentration
avg_percent_stackplot <- ggplot(avg_concentration_percent, aes(x = X8.day.seascapes, y = mean_concentration_percent, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spp_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = seascape_labels) +
  labs(x = "Seascape class", y = "Relative concentration (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = font_size, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = font_size, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = font_size)
  )
print(avg_percent_stackplot)
```

# # Prepare data frames for CV analysis below with mean plankton densities per seascape using station data (same results as above)
```{r}
taxa_meta_concentration_all_seascapes <- taxa_meta %>%
  mutate(across(c(Centric,Ceratium,Chaetoceros,Chain2,Chain3,Guinardia,Neocalyptrella,
                   Noctiluca,Tricho,Acantharea,Chaetognaths,Ostracods,Copepods,Decapods,Echinoderms,Jellies,
    Larvaceans,Polychaets,Pteropods), ~ ./total_vol_sampled * 1e6)) %>%
  select(Station, dec_lat, dec_lon, year, month, date, total_vol_sampled,Avg.chl.a..ug.L.,
         temp..degC., salinity, DO..mg.L.,NH4...uM.,PO4...uM.,NO3.NO2..uM., Si.....uM.,X8.day.seascapes,
         Centric,Ceratium,Chaetoceros,Chain2,Chain3,Guinardia,Neocalyptrella,
                   Noctiluca,Tricho,Acantharea,Chaetognaths,Ostracods,Copepods,Decapods,Echinoderms,
         Jellies,Larvaceans,Polychaets,Pteropods) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_vol_sampled)) 

# # Transform taxa_meta_concentration to long format
taxa_meta_long_all_seascapes <- taxa_meta_concentration_all_seascapes %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Centric,Ceratium,Chaetoceros,Chain2,Chain3,Guinardia,Neocalyptrella,
                   Noctiluca,Tricho,Acantharea, Chaetognaths,Ostracods,Copepods,Decapods,
                        Echinoderms, Jellies, Larvaceans,Polychaets, Pteropods),
               names_to = "species", values_to = "species_concentration")

summary_tbl_concentrations_seascapes <- taxa_meta_long_all_seascapes %>%
  group_by(X8.day.seascapes, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_species_concentration = mean(species_concentration[species_concentration != 0], na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_species_concentration = sd(species_concentration[species_concentration != 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# filter table by group of species
summary_tbl_filtered <- summary_tbl_concentrations_seascapes %>%
  filter(species %in% c("Centric","Ceratium","Chaetoceros","Chain2","Chain3","Guinardia","Neocalyptrella", "Noctiluca","Tricho")) %>%
    # filter(species %in% c("Acantharea","Chaetognaths","Ostracods","Copepods","Decapods","Echinoderms","Jellies","Larvaceans","Polychaets","Pteropods")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(X8.day.seascapes)) %>%
  filter(!is.nan(mean_species_concentration))

print(summary_tbl_filtered)
```

```{r}
coeff_var$species <- factor(coeff_var$species, levels = rev(species_order))

heatmap <- ggplot(coeff_var, aes(x = seascape_class, y = species, fill = coef_var)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred", limits = c(0.02,4.5), name = "CV") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 32, angle = 0, color = "black"),
    # axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 22)) 
heatmap
```

# # Create plots showing coefficient of variation of plankton RELATIVE CONCENTRATION per seascape
```{r}
# Calculate relative abundances per class for each cruise using year and month
tmp_summary_relabund <- taxa_meta_long_all_seascapes %>%
    # filter(species %in% c("Centric","Ceratium","Chaetoceros","Chain2","Chain3","Guinardia","Neocalyptrella", "Noctiluca","Tricho")) %>%
      filter(species %in% c("Acantharea","Chaetognaths","Ostracods","Copepods","Decapods","Echinoderms","Jellies","Larvaceans","Polychaets","Pteropods")) %>%
  group_by(year, month, X8.day.seascapes) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = species_concentration / sum(species_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, X8.day.seascapes, species) %>%
  summarise(total_relative_abundance = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Calculate mean, sd, and cv of relative abundance per seascape
cv_summary_relabund <- tmp_summary_relabund %>%
  group_by(X8.day.seascapes, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_relabund = mean(total_relative_abundance[total_relative_abundance != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_relabund = sd(total_relative_abundance[total_relative_abundance != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    coef_var_relabund = sd_relabund / mean_relabund
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(X8.day.seascapes)) %>%
  filter(!is.nan(mean_relabund))

cv_summary_relabund$seascape_class <- factor(cv_summary_relabund$X8.day.seascapes,
                                   levels = c(3, 11, 13, 15, 21, 27),
                                   labels = c("TST", "TSU", "SGMI", "TS", "WBHN", "HE"))

species_labels <- c(
  "Acantharea" = "Aca",
  "Chaetognaths" = "Cha",
  "Copepods" = "Cop",
  "Decapods" = "Dec",
  "Echinoderms" = "Ech",

  "Larvaceans" = "Lar",
  "Ostracods" = "Ost",
  "Polychaets" = "Pol",
  "Pteropods" = "Pte"
)

cv_summary_relabund <- cv_summary_relabund %>%
  mutate(species = recode(species, !!!species_labels))

heatmap <- ggplot(cv_summary_relabund, aes(x = seascape_class, y = species, fill = coef_var_relabund)) +
```
